title: Documents
description: Employee documents, expiry monitoring and compliance.
myDescription: Your documents on file, their review status and upcoming expiry dates.

kpi.expiringSoonHint: {count, plural, =0 {None within 7 days} other {# within 7 days}}
kpi.missingHint: {count, plural, =0 {All employees complete} one {# employee} other {# employees}}
kpi.uploadedHint: {count, plural, =0 {None this month} other {# this month}}
kpi.myTotalHint: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing pending review} other {# pending review}}

placeholders.selectEmployee: Search by name or employee ID
placeholders.rejectReason: Explain what needs to be corrected…

expiry.daysLeft: {count, plural, =0 {Expires today} one {# day left} other {# days left}}
expiry.expiredAgo: {count, plural, one {Expired # day ago} other {Expired # days ago}}
expiry.lastRunAlerts: {count, plural, =0 {no new alerts} one {# item alerted} other {# items alerted}}
expiry.neverRun: No expiry check has run yet
expiry.schedule: Checked automatically every day. HR and the employee are alerted {days} days before expiry.

missing.rule: Every active employee needs an employment contract and the ID document matching their ID type (Iqama or National ID). Non-Saudi employees also need a passport. Uploads waiting for review count as submitted.

review.approveDescription: The document is added to {name}'s file.
review.rejectDescription: {name} will see your reason and can upload a corrected copy.
review.selfReview: You can't review your own upload.
review.bannerTitle: {count, plural, one {# document is waiting for review} other {# documents are waiting for review}}
review.bannerDescription: Employees' uploads are added to their files once HR approves them.
review.noPermission: You can see uploads waiting for review. Approving or rejecting them needs the Approve documents permission.

upload.title: Upload document
upload.description: Attach the file and its details. PDF, JPG, PNG or WebP up to 10 MB.
upload.selfNotice: HR reviews your document before it's added to your file.
upload.confidentialHint: Only HR can see confidential documents. Medical reports are always confidential.
upload.noAccess: You can't upload documents for this employee.
upload.notLinked: Your account isn't linked to an employee record yet. Contact HR to upload documents.
upload.loadFailed: Couldn't prepare the upload. Please try again.
upload.expiryHint: Used for expiry alerts and the expiry monitor.

replace.title: Replace file
replace.description: Upload a new file for this document. The current file is removed once the new one is saved.

edit.title: Edit document details
edit.description: Update the document's details. The file stays the same.
edit.statusHint: Set from the expiry date automatically. Change it only to correct a record.

details.title: Document details
details.previewUnavailable: Preview isn't available for this file type.

delete.title: Delete this document?
delete.description: The document and its file are permanently removed. This can't be undone.
delete.withdrawDescription: Your upload is removed before HR reviews it. You can upload it again later.

archive.title: Archive this document?
archive.description: Archived documents are hidden from lists, the expiry monitor and alerts. You can restore them later.

runCheck.title: Run the expiry check now?
runCheck.description: Alerts HR and the employees concerned about items that reached a new alert threshold since the last check, by notification and email. Items already alerted are skipped.
runCheck.result: {items, plural, =0 {No new alerts — everything is up to date.} one {Alerts sent for # item.} other {Alerts sent for # items.}}

validation.expiryBeforeIssue: The expiry date can't be before the issue date.
validation.reasonRequired: Enter the reason for the rejection.

errors.archived: Archived documents can't be changed. Restore the document first.
errors.reviewState: Pending and rejected uploads can't be archived. Review or delete them instead.

empty.documentsDescription: Employee documents appear here once they're uploaded.
empty.expiryDescription: Iqama, passport, contract, insurance and document expiry dates appear here once they're recorded.
empty.missingTitle: All required documents are on file
empty.missingDescription: Every active employee has their ID document, passport (when required) and employment contract.
empty.reviewDescription: Documents uploaded by employees appear here for approval.
empty.myDescription: Upload your Iqama, passport, certificates and other documents for HR to keep on file.
empty.myExpiryDescription: Your Iqama, passport, insurance and document expiry dates will appear here.

my.expiryDescription: From your employee record, insurance, dependents and documents.
my.guide1: Upload a clear scan or photo — PDF, JPG, PNG or WebP up to 10 MB.
my.guide2: HR reviews each upload and adds approved documents to your file.
my.guide3: If a document is rejected, you'll see the reason and can upload a corrected copy.

profileTab.complianceDescription: Required documents and the next expiry dates.
profileTab.documentsCount: {count, plural, =0 {No documents} one {# document} other {# documents}}
profileTab.restrictedDescription: Only HR and the employee can see an employee's documents.
